confidenceNote: Welcome offers change monthly. Every offer is verified: secondary, and a conflict says where two sites disagree. data/library/cards.json leaves bonuses out on purpose; this file is the separate, dated layer for them.
note: cardId is the card's id in data/library/cards.json, or null for a Chase card the library does not hold yet (earnWords carries what it earns until it joins the library). bonus.amount is in bonus.unit; null means the sites disagree and no dollar value is counted. spend is what must be charged within months of opening; 0 means no spending needed. An offer marked upTo is the most the issuer shows anyone. spendKnown false means today's sources did not say what must be spent. skip says why an offer with no agreed amount is left out. firstYearFee is the fee in the first year when it differs. Units marked cashable can be taken as cash, so they are never held back as a program.
